'''Ozuun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Argullian]] who lived on [[Argul]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Ozuun was an outspoken critic of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and this made him unpopular among his fellow [[Argullian]]s after [[Argul]] was [[Battle of Argul|attacked]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A crowd of Argullians accused him of being a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and surrounded him. However the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Mariineh]], [[Teo Gronn]] and [[Shalimin]] noticed what was going on and tried to calm the crowd and prove Ozuun's innocence.
